description: The information related to an authenticator.

authenticator_id.description: The id of the authenticator(phone number in case of SMS authenticators and email id in case of email).

type.description: The type of the authenticator to add. SOFT and HARD are deprecated types. New integrations should use SMS.

x-enum.description: Indicates that the authenticator is SMS.
Indicates that the authenticator is Email.
Indicates that the authenticator is Card.
Indicates that the authenticator is Bank.

state.description: Indicates the current state of the authenticator.

x-enum.description: Indicates that the authenticator is Active.
Indicates that the authenticaton using the authenticator is Abandonded.
Indicates that the authenticaton using the authenticator has failed.
